scope: Synthetic, same-model causal planning. These results are not real-video validation, learned physics, held-out forecast accuracy, or safety certification. Initial positions, masses and contact coefficients are supplied. Each intervention is a single idealized instantaneous velocity change.
prediction_protocol: Every counterfactual trajectory is computed and frozen at simulation time zero, before any playback. Both worlds use identical initial conditions except for the stated action. The displayed playback is a visualization of these frozen trajectories.
robustness_protocol: Diagnostic evaluation of the chosen nominal action with lead-carrier speed scaled by 0.95, 1 and 1.05. The nominal optimizer does not optimize these extra checks. A failure remains visible.
deadline_protocol: Search at nine delays from 0 to 2 seconds in 0.25-second increments. Last successful tested delay is not a continuous feasibility boundary.

scenario.title: Réaction en chaîne
scenario.description: Un chariot percute une file de charges. Le dernier transporteur porte un équipement fragile.
scenario.challenge: Couper la chaîne avant le premier contact.

modelDisclosure.integrator: exact linear-drag free flight + discrete frictionless impulses, fixed 240 Hz
modelDisclosure.intervention: one instantaneous bounded velocity change; actuator dynamics not modeled

results.objective: Among evaluated actions below the protected-impact energy threshold, minimize applied impulse. If none succeeds, minimize protected-impact energy, then impulse.

deadline.scope: Last safe delay among a 0.25-second grid and the stated discrete intervention set; not a continuous guarantee.

speed_sensitivity.scope: Three simulated speed checks only; no probabilistic or physical guarantee.
